footer.tagline: Kisan Sahayak — built for farmers, works on any phone.

hero.title: Know what your field needs, before you step into it.
hero.lede: Weather, market prices, crop advice and disease checks — built for the phone in your pocket and the field you already know better than any app.
hero.note: No smartphone data plan? Your daily report also comes by WhatsApp.

features.title: Six things you'd otherwise call five different people for.
features.subtitle: Each one answers a question you already ask — just faster, and specific to your field and your soil.

crop.title: Crop, fertiliser and yield, worked out for your soil
crop.desc: Tell it your soil type and field size once — it fills in the rest from live weather and your location, and tells you what to plant, what to feed it, and what to expect at harvest.

photo.title: Photo diagnosis
photo.desc: Photograph a leaf or soil sample for an instant read on disease and treatment.

market.title: Local market prices
market.desc: Real prices from your district, with trends so you know if a price is worth waiting on.

weather.title: Weather by field
weather.desc: Forecasts tied to your exact village, not the nearest big city.

chat.title: Ask it anything, anytime
chat.desc: A chat that knows your farm's history — ask in plain language, get an answer grounded in real agricultural guidance.

dashboardPreview.title: One screen, every morning.
dashboardPreview.subtitle: Prices, weather and anything that needs your attention today — before you head out.

news.title: What's happening in agriculture today.
news.subtitle: Pulled fresh from the news feed, updated as it publishes.
news.loadError: Couldn't load news right now — check that the backend is running.
news.empty: No news articles found right now.

cta.title: Set up your farm profile once. Get advice suited to it every day after.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Check today's weather, prices, and advice for your farm.
login.error: Login failed. Check your username and password.

register.title: Create your free account
register.subtitle: Takes about a minute. No cost, ever.
register.error: Registration failed. Try a different username.

adminLogin.title: Admin login
adminLogin.subtitle: For platform administrators only.
adminLogin.error: Login failed. Check your email and password.

onboarding.saveError: Couldn't save your profile. Try again.

languageStep.title: Which language should we use?
languageStep.subtitle: This changes the language for your whole account — chat, reports, and the rest of this setup.

soilStep.title: What's your soil type?
soilStep.subtitle: If you're not sure, pick your best guess — you can update this later.

farmSizeStep.title: How big is your farm?
farmSizeStep.subtitle: In acres. A rough estimate is fine.

cropsStep.title: What do you usually grow?
cropsStep.subtitle: Pick as many as apply. This shapes your market prices and advice.
cropsStep.selectAtLeastOne: Select at least one crop to continue.

irrigationStep.title: How do you water your fields?
irrigationStep.subtitle: Your main source — it's fine if you use more than one sometimes.

problemStep.title: What's your biggest challenge right now?
problemStep.subtitle: We'll prioritize advice around this.

locationStep.title: Where's your farm?
locationStep.subtitle: Used for weather, and to find local prices and news.
locationStep.autofillNote: Auto-filled from your location — double check and correct if anything's off.
locationStep.geoFailed: Couldn't get your location. Allow location access and try again.
locationStep.geoPartialFail: Got your location, but couldn't fill in the address automatically — please enter it below.

dashboardHome.noPrices: No price data yet for your crops
dashboardHome.cropToolsDesc: Get crop, fertilizer and yield advice
dashboardHome.visionDesc: Check a leaf or soil photo

cropTools.title: Crop tools
cropTools.subtitle: Recommendations built from your soil, weather, and farm profile.
cropTools.cropAutoNote: We use your soil type, location, and today's weather automatically — nothing to fill in.
cropTools.fertilizerAutoNote: Soil and weather are auto-loaded from your profile. Just pick your crop.
cropTools.lowSampleNote: Fewer training examples for this fertilizer — treat with a bit more caution
cropTools.npkDeficit: Your NPK vs. what this crop needs
cropTools.deficitExplain: Positive means your soil has less than the crop needs; negative means you already have more than enough.
cropTools.outOfRangeWarning: This prediction is outside the range the model was trained on for this combination — treat it as a rough estimate only.
cropTools.error: Couldn't get a result right now. Try again.

vision.title: Photo check
vision.subtitle: Snap a photo of a leaf or your soil for an instant read.
vision.diseaseNote: Take a clear, close-up photo of the affected leaf in good light.
vision.soilNote: Take a clear photo of your soil in daylight, without shadows.
vision.uploadLeafPhoto: Upload or take a leaf photo
vision.uploadSoilPhoto: Upload or take a soil photo
vision.profileUpdated: Your soil type has been updated on your profile.
vision.error: Couldn't process that photo. Try again with a clearer image.
